name: connect-wallet
title: Connect Wallet
description: A complete connect, identity, and disconnect surface wired to wagmi.
docs:
```tsx
import { ConnectWallet } from "@/components/ui/connect-wallet"

<ConnectWallet />
```

Requires a `WagmiProvider` and a TanStack `QueryClientProvider` above it. The component renders the connectors configured in wagmi. For mobile browsers, configure a remote connector such as wagmi's `metaMask()` or `walletConnect()`; `injected()` alone only works when the current browser exposes a wallet provider.
